title: BearlyCopy CLI JSON API, version 1
description: Envelope written by every `prompt-relay <command> --json`. `data` follows $defs/<command>_data (see docs/JSON_API.md §3). Closed for the producer; consumers must ignore unknown fields and unknown enum values.

completion.description: Phase 9.4: answer | answer_background_running | waiting_background | intermediate | working | no_text | api_error | unknown. Stop only means the agent stopped; readers accept unknown values.

continued_in_turn.description: Phase 9.4: the later turn of this session that followed a Stop with work in flight.

native_session_id.description: Phase 12: the agent's own session id when the stored key was scoped to a non-default profile.

attention.description: Phase 12.1: the agent waits for the person (needs-input signal not yet followed by activity). Absent otherwise. Never an answer.

kind.description: question | plan_approval | permission | elicitation | input (readers accept unknown values)

last_signal_at.description: Phase 12.1: newest signal of this wait (repeats re-confirm it). Readers judge how certain a long wait still is; the Core never ends a wait by time.

display_preview.description: Requests only (Phase 5.11): the start of the request without automated blocks and paste wrappers, for display; null when nothing else remains.
Requests only (Phase 5.11): the start of the request without automated blocks and paste wrappers, for display; null when nothing else remains.

request_origin.description: Where the request came from (Phase 5.11): user, user_pasted, automated (a turn Claude Code started itself) or unknown. Read from the text's structure; null without a request.

earlier_user_request.description: For an automated turn: the latest earlier request from the user in the same session; else null.

continues_request.description: Phase 9.3, optional: for a short continuation request (such as "continue"), the latest earlier substantive request of the same session, offered as labelled context; the turn's own request stays verbatim.

completion.description: Phase 9.4: answer | answer_background_running | waiting_background | intermediate | working | no_text | api_error | unknown. Stop only means the agent stopped; readers accept unknown values.

continued_in_turn.description: Phase 9.4: the later turn of this session that followed a Stop with work in flight.

work_chain.description: Phase 9.4, show only: earlier intermediate turns of this session continued by this one; their observed files and the request time that started the task.

commands_nonzero.description: Shell commands of any kind that exited non-zero (Phase 5.11).

display_preview.description: Requests only (Phase 5.11): the start of the request without automated blocks and paste wrappers, for display; null when nothing else remains.

earlier_text_summary.description: A request from an earlier turn of the same session, with that turn's number.

display_preview.description: Requests only (Phase 5.11): the start of the request without automated blocks and paste wrappers, for display; null when nothing else remains.

earlier_text_full.description: A request from an earlier turn of the same session, with that turn's number.

basis.description: enabled_project | git_root | workspace | directory (Phase 9.3); readers accept unknown values

profile.description: Phase 12: the local agent profile = the agent's configuration home (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME). Never an account; credentials are never read. Absent for older Claude Code records (Unassigned).

id.description: cc-default | cx-default | cc-<16 hex> | cx-<16 hex>

hint.description: ~/<folder> under the home folder, else the last path component; never a user name

results_data.description: Phase 12: final results of every session, newest answer first.

context_pack_data.description: Phase 13 (context-pack): several results in one hand-off. `results[].section` is one result's Markdown body (Copy with Context one heading level deeper); `text` is the whole pack (docs/CONTEXT_PACK.md). The format is versioned on its own (`format_version`).

text.description: The whole pack; empty when external slots are present (the app composes it).

position.description: Place in the pack, counting external slots (imports the app fills).

context_pack_result_manifest.description: Phase 13: facts about one result for the manifest: no paths, session ids or text.
